as
approved
by the relevant regulations and instructions shall not mean a waiver thereof.
Article No. (9): Procedures for Exercising the Right to Terminate the
Contract
1
Subject to what is stated in Article No. (10) of the Contract, the Beneficiary may
terminate the Contract by providing the Financer with a written notice (hardcopy or
softcopy) to any of the addresses indicated in the contact data for the purpose of the
notices
indicated
in
the
introduction
of
the
Contract
to
the
Financer
within
a
period
of
(10)
days
as
of
the
date
of
concluding
the
Contract.
The
Financier
may
then
request
documents
proving that the conditions mentioned in Clause No. (92) of this article have not been
fulfilled by the Beneficiary.
2
The
Beneficiary
shall
not
have
the
right
to
exercise
the
right
to
terminate
the
Contract
if
one of the following conditions is met:
2.1
If the
Beneficiary withdraws
any part
of the
finance
amount.
If the Beneficiary uses any means of obtaining financing provided to it by the
Financer
to
obtain
items
or
services,
including
the
deposit
of
shares
in
the
portfolio
of the Beneficiary, while the Beneficiary owns or uses the asset of the Financer.
2.2
If
the
Beneficiary
uses
any
means
of
obtaining
financing
provided
to
it
by
the
Financer
to
obtain
items
or
services,
including
the
deposit
of
shares
in
the
portfolio
of the Beneficiary, while the Beneficiary owns or uses the asset of the Financer.
3
In
the
event
of
termination
of
the
Contract
under
Clause
No.
(9.1)
of
this
Article,
the
Financer
shall
not
impose
any
term
cost
(profit)
or
fees,
or
claim
any
commissions
from
the
Beneficiary.
Article
No.
(10):
Provisions
for Early Payment
1
The
Beneficiary may,
at
any time,
apply for
early payment.
2
The Financer shall have the right to claim the amounts mentioned below from the
Beneficiary to enable it to pay the full amount in advance, which are as follows:
2.1
The
remaining amount
of the
finance
amount
2.2
The reinvestment cost (profit), not exceeding the term cost (profit ) for the
installments of the three months following the last installment due before the
Beneficiary
submits
the
request
for
early
full
payment
according
to
the
installments
schedule contained in Appendix No. (1)
2.3
The
non-refundable
expenses,
paid
by
the
Financer
to
a
third
party
due
to
the
Contract, which the Financer must prove.
3
The
Beneficiary
shall
pay
the
early
full
payment
amount
due
within
(7)
working
days
from
the
notification
date
thereof.
The
Financer
shall
issue
a
clearance
letter
to
the
Beneficiary
within
a
period
not
exceeding
one
working
day,
as
stipulated
in
the
instructions
of
the
time
periods
for
issuing
the
party's
clearance
letter,
transferring
the
indebtedness
and
updating
its
credit record with credit information companies.
Article
No. (11):
Administrative
Costs and Fees
1
The Beneficiary is obligated to pay the administrative costs and fees agreed upon in
Article
No.
(5)
of
the
Contract,
provided
that
the
total
of
these
administrative
costs
and
fees
does
not
exceed
(5,000)
riyals
or
(1%)
of
the
financing,
whichever
is
less,
and
this
does not include government taxes.
2
The Financer shall bear the costs and fees for which the Contract stipulates its
responsibility or the relevant regulations and instructions stipulate that it shall bear such
responsibility.
